column4: Reconcile each true-up to the legacy trial balance and close the FY2027 cut-off
column6:
As the Data Migration Lead, I need to reconcile all migrated data per data object, so that every data object and item is reconcilable from source to target after the cut-over.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRID_MIG 1.2 (p.7); BRID_MIG 12.1 (p.13); BRID_MIG 13.1 (p.14)
* FRS: Data Migration Handbook BRD-13 Data Migration v2.1 (02_BIBS_Handbook_BRD-13_Data_Migration_v2.1.docx), section 20.3 Reconciliation, FR-DM-024 Reconcile each true-up to the legacy trial balance and close the FY2027 cut-off
* Persona: Head, Comptrollership; Data Migration Lead; Program Manager
* Function: Each true-up is reconciled to the legacy trial balance before it is signed, and the legacy GL stays under cut-off controls until the final true-up. The checks are cut-off (every legacy journal since the freeze is in the register and in a true-up, dated in FY2027 and posted by a named Comptrollership user, and no legacy business module posted after the freeze), movement (the true-up equals the change of the legacy trial balance since the previous true-up), balance (the BIBS opening balances equal the legacy trial balance of the true-up), Migration Clearing and the legacy sub-ledgers, and, when the opening period was reopened, no other journal in it during the window.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Movement - per BIBS account, branch and currency, the true-up lines equal the legacy trial balance of the true-up minus the legacy trial balance of the previous true-up (or of the provisional opening), both mapped through the GL account code map, with the P&L netted into retained earnings. (Fixed)
* (R2) Balance - per BIBS account, branch and currency, the provisional opening plus true-ups 1 to n equal the legacy trial balance of true-up n; Migration Clearing is 0.00; the legacy control accounts equal their sub-ledgers. (Fixed)
* (R3) Cut-off - the legacy journal listing since the freeze equals the FY2027 adjustment register and the true-up journals; no journal is dated outside FY2027; no posting user is outside the Comptrollership access list; no legacy business module posted after the freeze. (Fixed)
* (R4) A true-up with a break cannot be signed. (Fixed)
* (R5) After the closure no further true-up can be created, and the opening journals lose the Provisional flag. (Fixed)
* Check: Legacy journal not in the true-up. Message: "Legacy journal (no) posted on (date) is not in the adjustment register or the true-up"
* Check: Movement differs. Message: "(account) (branch) (currency) - true-up (x), legacy trial balance change (y)"
* Check: Balance differs. Message: "(account) (branch) (currency) - BIBS opening (x), legacy trial balance (y)"
* Check: Sign-off with a break. Message: "Check (check) is not met"
* Check: New true-up after closure. Message: "The FY2027 true-ups are closed"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the true-up is posted (FR-DM-023) and true-up 1, when BIBS runs the report Opening-Balance Adjustment Reconciliation after the posting, then the report Opening-Balance Adjustment Reconciliation shows each account's true-up equal to the change of the legacy trial balance, the BIBS opening equal to the legacy post-close trial balance, and Migration Clearing 0.00.
* (AC2) Given the true-up is posted (FR-DM-023), when BIBS runs the report Opening-Balance Adjustment Reconciliation after the posting, then a legacy journal that is in the legacy journal listing but not in the register stops the sign-off with the message.
* (AC3) Given the true-up is posted (FR-DM-023), when BIBS runs the report Opening-Balance Adjustment Reconciliation after the posting, then after the final true-up is signed and the closure recorded, a new true-up cannot be created and the opening journals are no longer marked Provisional.

*Out of scope / notes*
* No open clarification on this FR.

column4: Match and deduplicate legacy clients
column6:
As a Marketing User, I need the client master available in BIBS, so that I can service clients, renew policies and create new transactions without re-encoding identities.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRID_MIG 2.1 (p.8-9)
* FRS: Data Migration Handbook BRD-13 Data Migration v2.1 (02_BIBS_Handbook_BRD-13_Data_Migration_v2.1.docx), section 20.4 Client master and reference data, FR-DM-031 Match and deduplicate legacy clients
* Persona: BIBS; Data Steward
* Function: Legacy clients of all source systems are matched with each other and with clients already in BIBS before any is loaded. Exact matches on hard keys merge automatically; likely matches go to the Data Steward's review queue; the rest become new clients. The keys start from the BIBS duplicate keys (TIN, ID type and number, name with birth date, corporate name) and the keys BDOI agrees (DMQ04).

*Business rules*
* (R1) Scores - TIN 100; ID type and number 100; name with birth date 95; corporate name with registration number 95, without 90; bank CIF 100 if agreed; e-mail 40; mobile 40; similar name with the same birth date or city 70. (Configurable)
* (R2) Auto-merge at the automatic merge score (default 90); review from the review score (default 60). (Configurable)
* (R3) Survivorship per field - first non-blank by source priority, or the latest updated value when the update date is given. (Configurable)
* (R4) The client batch cannot be approved for load while the review queue has open pairs. (Fixed)
* Check: Load approval with open review pairs. Message: "(n) client pairs are waiting for review"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the client batch is being validated (FR-DM-013) and two legacy clients with the same TIN from EBIX and QPS, when BIBS scores every candidate pair on the keys, then they become one BIBS client with both legacy keys in the cross-reference.
* (AC2) Given the client batch is being validated (FR-DM-013), when BIBS scores every candidate pair on the keys, then two legacy clients with similar names and the same birth date but different IDs go to the review queue.
* (AC3) Given the client batch is being validated (FR-DM-013), when BIBS scores every candidate pair on the keys, then the client batch cannot load while a pair is open in the review queue.

column4: Load in-force policy headers
column6:

* Persona: BIBS (header load); Data Migration Lead
* Function: When the condition of BRID_MIG 4.1 is met (DMQ09), the in-force legacy policies are loaded as BIBS accounts with a minimal header - status, key dates, insurer and shares, line of business and product, policy number, sum insured, currency, AO, unit and branch, payment arrangement and PN numbers - linked to the migrated client.

*Business rules*
* (R1) A migrated header has the origin Migrated, the status Booked and the legacy reference; it has no BIBS invoice of its own. (Fixed)
* (R2) Headers in scope follow the condition decided for the object (all in-force policies, or those with open legacy invoices, as BDOI decides). (Configurable)
* (R3) Always in scope - every policy expiring from go-live to the end of the go-live renewal window (31 May 2028) and every renewal term booked in legacy that starts on or after go-live. (Fixed)
* (R4) The legacy package code and version are kept as given; no package is resolved at load. (Fixed)
* Check: Expiry before inception. Message: "The expiry date is before the inception date"
* Check: Insurer shares not 100. Message: "Insurer shares add up to (x) percent"

* (AC1) Given Clients and reference data are accepted and a migrated in-force policy, when the operator validates and loads the header batch, then it is found by its policy number and shows status, dates, insurer and line, linked to the correct client.
* (AC2) Given Clients and reference data are accepted and a migrated header, when the operator validates and loads the header batch, then it has no quotation or placement and cannot be booked again.
* (AC3) Given Clients and reference data are accepted and a packaged header, when the operator validates and loads the header batch, then it shows the legacy package and version as sent, with no warning.

column4: Carry forward legacy invoices with their open balances
column6:
As a Cashiering user, I need legacy unapplied payments auto-applied by the automatch rerun to booked legacy and new invoices, so that payments are applied efficiently and the sub-ledgers are updated correctly.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRID_MIG 5.2 (p.9-10); BRID_MIG 6.1 (p.10); BRID_MIG 8.1 (p.11-12); BRID_MIG 10.1 (p.12); BRID_MIG 13.1 (p.14)
* FRS: Data Migration Handbook BRD-13 Data Migration v2.1 (02_BIBS_Handbook_BRD-13_Data_Migration_v2.1.docx), section 20.6 Legacy open items and UPP, FR-DM-050 Carry forward legacy invoices with their open balances
* Persona: BIBS (open invoice load); Reconciliation approver
* Function: Every legacy invoice open at cutover (premium receivable, premium paid and not remitted, commission receivable or PR2307 still open) enters the BIBS Operations ledger with the origin Legacy. It keeps its legacy number, source system and legacy reference. Each component is loaded with its original amount and what was paid, remitted, adjusted or written off in legacy, so its open balance equals the legacy open balance.

*Business rules*
* (R1) A legacy invoice has the origin Legacy and the legacy ledger context; all its postings use the legacy components that Comptrollership maps to the legacy sub-ledgers. (Fixed)
* (R2) Legacy invoices are not part of the production register extract (they were reconciled in legacy). (Fixed)
* (R3) Opening entries are dated the cutover date; foreign-currency amounts use the rate decided in DMQ35. (Configurable)
* Check: Open balance outside 0 and booked. Message: "The open balance of (component) is outside the booked amount"
* Check: Invoice number used twice in one source. Message: "Invoice (no) appears twice"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given Clients, insurers, products and, where applicable, headers are accepted and a legacy invoice with PR 10,000.00 of which 4,000.00 was paid, when the operator validates and loads the open invoice batch, then it shows booked 10,000.00, applied 4,000.00 and balance 6,000.00 in Invoice 360, with the LEGACY badge.
* (AC2) Given Clients, insurers, products and, where applicable, headers are accepted, when the operator validates and loads the open invoice batch, then a legacy invoice paid in full before cutover and not remitted is offered for remittance (FR-DM-080) and not for collection.
* (AC3) Given Clients, insurers, products and, where applicable, headers are accepted, when the operator validates and loads the open invoice batch, then Invoice 360 of a legacy invoice shows the source system, legacy number and original values.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-DM-03 - open, for BDOI confirmation: History in BRID_MIG 1.3, 10.1, 13.1 and 14.1. Proposed: The selective principle of the BRD (p.3, p.5) stands. 'Transaction history' (13.1) and 'no loss of historical information' (14.1) mean the movements of the items that are still open (booked, paid, remitted, adjusted and written off per component), loaded with each item; the GL beginning balance is the balance-sheet opening at 31 December 2027 per branch and currency, trued up after the legacy close and the audited statements. Closed transactions, expired policies, settled items and GL history go to the BIBS archive or stay in read-only legacy and are searched in Legacy Inquiry (BRID_MIG 11.1). 'Client-related data' means the client master, payout accounts and the client of every open item Decision requested: The Program Manager, the Head of Comptrollership and the Head of Operations confirm the reading of 'history'
* CLR-DM-15 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Direct-payment invoices (note of BRID_MIG 6.1). Proposed: The direct-payment flag of the legacy invoice extract (F01) is filled only where legacy holds it; the DP PR reversal list comes from the Collections tag 'DP PR for reversal' or an approved list, not from a legacy flag Decision requested: The Head of Comptrollership and Operations confirm how a direct-payment invoice is identified and the meaning of DP PR
* CLR-DM-18 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Negative endorsements with zero premium receivable (BRID_MIG 9.2). Proposed: For every migrated policy header, the legacy invoices of its current term are loaded even when fully settled, with zero open balance and no opening entry, so positive, negative (including zero premium receivable) and non-financial endorsements can reference them; endorsements of legacy invoices are processed only in BIBS from go-live. Until BDOI confirms, object F01 carries the invoices with an open component only Decision requested: The Head of Operations confirms the load of the settled invoices of the current term

column4: Automatch rerun of UPP across legacy and new invoices
column6:
As a Cashiering user, I need unapplied payments that combine amounts for new and legacy invoices auto-applied, so that mixed payments are allocated correctly across both kinds of invoice.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRID_MIG 5.2 (p.9-10); BRID_MIG 6.3 (p.11)
* FRS: Data Migration Handbook BRD-13 Data Migration v2.1 (02_BIBS_Handbook_BRD-13_Data_Migration_v2.1.docx), section 20.6 Legacy open items and UPP, FR-DM-052 Automatch rerun of UPP across legacy and new invoices
* Persona: BIBS (payment automatch); Cashiering User
* Function: The payment automatch also takes migrated UPP items. It matches them on the references carried from legacy (invoice number, cover number, PN, payor reference) and applies the balance, oldest invoice first, to the booked invoices found - legacy or new. * Persona: BIBS (payment file handlers and matching); Cashiering User
* Function: Autopay payment files are uploaded as today. Payment rows that carry a legacy invoice number or reference (for example the EBIX reference of the Direct Credit file) are matched to the legacy invoice and applied as in FR-DM-060.

*Business rules*
* (R1) The matcher tries the BIBS invoice number, the legacy invoice number, ARN, policy number and PN in the order the row carries them. (Fixed)
* (R2) A legacy invoice number is recognised by the patterns of the legacy invoice number patterns (default the EBIX pattern I followed by 8 digits). The QPS pattern is added to it and to the invoice number patterns of Collections when DMQ11 gives the QPS format; until then a row for a QPS invoice is matched by ARN, policy number or PN, or stays unapplied. (Configurable)
* Check: Invalid row. Message: "As the payment file handlers"

* (AC2) Given the legacy invoice is loaded, when the Cashiering User uploads the file, then the AR issued for that row shows the legacy invoice number, and Invoice 360 of the invoice lists the AR.
* (AC3) Given the legacy invoice is loaded and a file with rows for legacy and new invoices, when the Cashiering User uploads the file, then it posts each application to the right sub-ledger.
* (AC4) Given the legacy invoice is loaded, when the Cashiering User uploads the file, then before the QPS pattern is configured, a row that quotes only a QPS invoice number stays unapplied, and a row that also quotes the ARN is applied to the QPS legacy invoice.

column4: Process a negative endorsement on a legacy invoice
column6:
As an Operations User, I need to process negative endorsements on legacy invoices, including those with zero premium receivable, so that premium decreases are reflected correctly and the renewal is based on the net endorsements.

* FRS: Data Migration Handbook BRD-13 Data Migration v2.1 (02_BIBS_Handbook_BRD-13_Data_Migration_v2.1.docx), section 20.10 Endorsements on legacy invoices, FR-DM-091 Process a negative endorsement on a legacy invoice
* Persona: Operations User; Adjustment TL
* Function: A negative financial endorsement (return premium, decrease, cancellation) of a legacy policy is processed like FR-DM-090, also when the legacy invoice has zero premium receivable (BRID_MIG 9.2) with a return invoice. Payments already applied are re-applied and any excess goes to UPP; if the premium was already remitted, the AR Insurer is set up; all on the legacy sub-ledgers. The account is updated, so the renewal is based on the net values.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Re-application and AR Insurer set-up of a legacy invoice use the legacy components. (Fixed)
* (R2) For a decrease of commission, the credit refers to the legacy service invoice number held on the frozen snapshot. (Fixed)

* (AC2) Given the Operations User is signed in to BIBS, when As FR-DM-090 with a negative type, then after the endorsement the account premium is the net premium used by Renewal.
* (AC3) Given the Operations User is signed in to BIBS, when As FR-DM-090 with a negative type, then a return premium of 500.00 on a legacy invoice paid in full and not remitted (zero premium receivable) creates an unapplied payment of 500.00 for the client and reduces DTIP legacy by 500.00.

* Persona: Prod Recon Analyst; Reporting User

(Configurable)
* (R4) Trial-migration load order - the tasks of objects R01-R07 and C01-C03 come first in every plan, and no policy, open-item or GL load starts before they are accepted (G6). (Fixed)

column4: Load the renewal advices already sent before go-live
column6:
As the Program Manager, I need the cut-over aligned to the renewal expiry month (RMEL), so that in-force policies run off and renew into BIBS in a controlled manner.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRID_MIG 12.1 (p.13); BRID_MIG 12.2 (p.13-14; second BRID_MIG 12.1)
* FRS: Data Migration Handbook BRD-13 Data Migration v2.1 (02_BIBS_Handbook_BRD-13_Data_Migration_v2.1.docx), section 20.13 Cutover and coexistence, FR-DM-125 Load the renewal advices already sent before go-live
* Persona: Renewal processing team (maker and checker); Migration Operator; Head of the Renewal processing team (data owner)
* Function: The RMEL and the dispositions are kept in Excel trackers today (DMQ38, answered 26 September 2026). The migration takes one thing from them - the renewal advices (RAs) already sent by hand before go-live for the expiries from go-live to 31 May 2028 - so that BIBS does not send them again. The trackers themselves are not migrated.

*Business rules*
* (R1) Rows are accepted for expiries from the go-live date to the end of the go-live renewal window (default 31 May 2028) whose header is in P01 and was not renewed in legacy. (Configurable)
* (R2) The RA date is not after the last legacy business day; an RA date more than 140 days before the expiry is a warning. (Fixed)
* (R3) A resubmission is approved by a checker who is not its maker; the checker holds the permission Data migration resubmit approve for object P03. (Fixed)
* (R4) In production, resubmissions are accepted until the resubmission deadline (default T-1 12:00). (Configurable)
* Check: Header not in P01. Message: "Cover (no) has no migrated header"
* Check: Expiry outside the window or different from the header. Message: "Expiry (date) is outside the go-live renewal window or differs from the header"
* Check: RA date after the last business day. Message: "RA date (date) is after the last legacy business day"
* Check: RA date early. Message: "RA date (date) is more than 140 days before expiry (expiry); check the tracker"
* Check: Already renewed in legacy. Message: "Cover (no) was already renewed in legacy as (ref); remove the row"
* Check: Checker is the maker. Message: "A record cannot be authorized by the user who maintained it"
* Check: Deadline passed. Message: "Resubmissions closed at (deadline)"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the policy headers (P01) of the same load are loaded and a file with the RA of C-2027-004512-01 sent on 16 November 2027 by e-mail, when the maker compiles the file from the trackers; the checker compares it with the trackers (row counts per tracker and 10 sample rows) and releases it, then it loads, and at go-live the candidate shows the RA as already sent.

column4: Continue the renewals in progress at the freeze (proposed position)
column6:
As the Data Migration Lead, I need to migrate the identified BDOI data objects (client, reference, policy, invoice and accounting data, and data kept outside the legacy systems), each record with its migrated flag and legacy source system, so that Day-1 operations continue, compliance is met and the migration risk is minimised.

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRID_MIG 12.2 (p.13-14; second BRID_MIG 12.1); BRID_MIG 1.3 (p.7-8)
* FRS: Data Migration Handbook BRD-13 Data Migration v2.1 (02_BIBS_Handbook_BRD-13_Data_Migration_v2.1.docx), section 20.13 Cutover and coexistence, FR-DM-126 Continue the renewals in progress at the freeze (proposed position)
* Persona: Renewal processing team; Renewal Processor; Data Migration Lead
* Function: BRD V0.03 asks that the renewal records in progress in the legacy renewal tracking system are migrated and continued in BIBS from their last stage, with an audit trail of migrated, skipped and failed records. BDOI answered on 26 September 2026 that no renewal in progress is carried (DMQ37, DMQ38). This FR states the proposed position for BDOI to confirm (CLR-DM-07, Drop 0 question DM-Q08); it does not add a migration of tracker stages.

*Business rules*
* (R1) No renewal stage is migrated from the legacy trackers; only the RAs already sent (P03) are loaded (BDOI answer of 26 September 2026, to be confirmed against BRD V0.03, CLR-DM-07). (Fixed)
* (R2) Per expiry month January-May 2028, headers expiring from the go-live date = candidates + renewals booked in legacy; a difference stops the go / no-go criterion 12. (Fixed)
* Check: Header not in P01. Message: "Cover (no) has no migrated header"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given the policy headers (P01) and the RA-sent file (P03) are loaded; the go-live extraction has run and a legacy renewal whose new term starts on 15 December 2027, when before the freeze, the Renewal processing team completes in legacy every renewal whose new term starts before go-live (completion drives from T-12), then it is booked in legacy before the freeze and its new term is found in BIBS as a migrated account with the origin Migrated.
* (AC2) Given the policy headers (P01) and the RA-sent file (P03) are loaded; the go-live extraction has run, when before the freeze, the Renewal processing team completes in legacy every renewal whose new term starts before go-live (completion drives from T-12), then at go-live the candidate of C-2027-004512-01 (expiry 15 January 2028) is urgent, shows the RA sent on 16 November 2027, and the processor records its disposition in BIBS.
* (AC3) Given the policy headers (P01) and the RA-sent file (P03) are loaded; the go-live extraction has run, when before the freeze, the Renewal processing team completes in legacy every renewal whose new term starts before go-live (completion drives from T-12), then the P03 batch log lists the loaded, rejected and resubmitted rows with their times and messages, and the extraction check balances for each expiry month January-May 2028.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-DM-07 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Renewals in progress (second BRID_MIG 12.1, read as 12.2). Proposed: The BDOI answer of 26 September 2026 prevails and is recorded in the annex: no renewal in progress is carried from the legacy trackers. A renewal whose new term starts before go-live is placed and booked in legacy before the freeze and migrates as an in-force header; the January-May 2028 expiries are processed in BIBS from the go-live extraction of the migrated headers, with the renewal advices already sent loaded from the trackers (P03) so they are not sent again; renewal premiums received in legacy are carried as unapplied payments (F02); the P03 batch gives the audit trail of loaded, rejected and resubmitted rows with timestamps and errors (FR-DM-126) Decision requested: The Heads of Retail and Corporate Marketing and the Head of the Renewal processing team confirm that the 26 September 2026 answer prevails, or list the stages and data to carry and their source

column4: Carry forward open legacy claims (on BDOI confirmation)
column6:
As a Claims User, I need the legacy claims available in BIBS and linked to their legacy policy details, so that I can continue processing claims end to end without interruption (on BDOI confirmation of CLR-DM-08).

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRID_MIG 14.1 (p.15); BRID_MIG 1.3 (p.7-8)
* FRS: Data Migration Handbook BRD-13 Data Migration v2.1 (02_BIBS_Handbook_BRD-13_Data_Migration_v2.1.docx), section 20.14 Claims and e-policies (proposed, for BDOI decision), FR-DM-130 Carry forward open legacy claims (on BDOI confirmation)
* Persona: Claims User; Data Migration Lead; Unit Head, Claims (data owner)
* Function: Each claim open at the freeze is loaded through the claims migration upload of the Claims module (object F07, Carry forward on confirmation) with its notification, insurer reference, reserve, payments made and documents, and is linked to the legacy policy header of its policy (loaded even if the policy has expired) and to the BIBS claim it becomes. The Claims User processes it end to end in BIBS (validation, adjudication, settlement, reporting).

*Business rules*
* (R1) Only claims open at the freeze are carried; closed claims are archived (CLR-DM-08). (Configurable)
* (R2) A carried claim keeps the legacy claim number and is linked to the legacy policy header and to its BIBS claim; it sends no notification to the client or the insurer at load. (Fixed)
* (R3) Reserve and paid amounts reconcile to the legacy claims extract with a difference of 0.00 per currency. (Fixed)
* Check: Policy header not found. Message: "Policy (no) of claim (claim) has no migrated header"
* Check: Claim already loaded. Message: "Claim (claim) is already loaded"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given BDOI has confirmed CLR-DM-08; the policy headers of the open claims are loaded; the Claims module is set up in the environment (Claims SIT before Trial migration 3) and an open claim with a reserve of 150,000.00 and 50,000.00 paid in legacy, when BDOI IT extracts the open claims and their policies; the operator uploads them with their control files, then it is found by its legacy claim number, shows the origin Migrated, the reserve and the payment, and opens its legacy policy header.
* (AC2) Given BDOI has confirmed CLR-DM-08; the policy headers of the open claims are loaded; the Claims module is set up in the environment (Claims SIT before Trial migration 3) and a claim whose policy has no header, when BDOI IT extracts the open claims and their policies; the operator uploads them with their control files, then it is rejected with its message.
* (AC3) Given BDOI has confirmed CLR-DM-08; the policy headers of the open claims are loaded; the Claims module is set up in the environment (Claims SIT before Trial migration 3), when BDOI IT extracts the open claims and their policies; the operator uploads them with their control files, then the claim reconciliation shows counts, reserves and paid amounts per currency with no difference.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-DM-03 - open, for BDOI confirmation: History in BRID_MIG 1.3, 10.1, 13.1 and 14.1. Proposed: The selective principle of the BRD (p.3, p.5) stands. 'Transaction history' (13.1) and 'no loss of historical information' (14.1) mean the movements of the items that are still open (booked, paid, remitted, adjusted and written off per component), loaded with each item; the GL beginning balance is the balance-sheet opening at 31 December 2027 per branch and currency, trued up after the legacy close and the audited statements. Closed transactions, expired policies, settled items and GL history go to the BIBS archive or stay in read-only legacy and are searched in Legacy Inquiry (BRID_MIG 11.1). 'Client-related data' means the client master, payout accounts and the client of every open item Decision requested: The Program Manager, the Head of Comptrollership and the Head of Operations confirm the reading of 'history'
* CLR-DM-08 - open, for BDOI confirmation: Claims data (BRID_MIG 14.1). Proposed: Open claims at the freeze are carried forward through the claims migration upload of the Claims module (object F07 becomes Carry forward), each with its notification, reserve, payments and documents and linked to the legacy policy header (loaded even if the policy has expired) and to the BIBS claim; closed claims are archived and searched in Legacy Inquiry. Claims are first loaded in Trial migration 3 (August 2027), after the Claims SIT. Until BDOI confirms, F07 stays Conditional and FR-DM-130 applies only on confirmation Decision requested: The Unit Head, Claims confirms which claims migrate (open only, or closed claims and for how many years), their source and the data owner

column4: Link e-policies to the migrated accounts (on BDOI confirmation)
column6:
As a Placement User, I need the e-policies received from insurers linked to the corresponding migrated accounts, so that the policy documents are associated and accessible in BIBS (on BDOI confirmation of CLR-DM-09).

*Background*
* BRD references and pages: BRID_MIG 14.2 (p.15-16)
* FRS: Data Migration Handbook BRD-13 Data Migration v2.1 (02_BIBS_Handbook_BRD-13_Data_Migration_v2.1.docx), section 20.14 Claims and e-policies (proposed, for BDOI decision), FR-DM-131 Link e-policies to the migrated accounts (on BDOI confirmation)
* Persona: Placement User; Migration Operator; Head, Operations (data owner)
* Function: The e-policies received from insurers for the in-force migrated accounts are loaded once, from an index file that names for each file the legacy account reference, the insurer, the insurer policy number, the file name and its checksum. BIBS matches each file to the migrated account on the insurer and the insurer policy number (the unique reference number of BRID_MIG 14.2) and links it to the account's documents, where it can be viewed and downloaded.

*Business rules*
* (R1) A file is linked only when exactly one migrated account matches on insurer and insurer policy number (CLR-DM-09). (Configurable)
* (R2) A linked e-policy is a document of the account: viewable and downloadable by the users who may open the account; every download is logged. (Fixed)
* Check: No matching account. Message: "E-policy (file) matches no migrated account"
* Check: Several matching accounts. Message: "E-policy (file) matches more than one account"
* Check: Checksum differs. Message: "File (file) does not match its checksum"

*Acceptance criteria*
* (AC1) Given BDOI has confirmed CLR-DM-09 and the matching reference; the policy headers (P01) are loaded, when BDOI IT places the e-policy files and the index file in the transfer folder; the operator uploads the index with its control file, then an e-policy whose insurer and insurer policy number match one migrated account is linked to it and can be viewed and downloaded from the account's documents.
* (AC2) Given BDOI has confirmed CLR-DM-09 and the matching reference; the policy headers (P01) are loaded and an e-policy that matches no account, when BDOI IT places the e-policy files and the index file in the transfer folder; the operator uploads the index with its control file, then it is not linked and appears on the exception report with its reason.
* (AC3) Given BDOI has confirmed CLR-DM-09 and the matching reference; the policy headers (P01) are loaded, when BDOI IT places the e-policy files and the index file in the transfer folder; the operator uploads the index with its control file, then the audit report lists every linked and failed file with the time and the reason.

*Out of scope / notes*
* CLR-DM-09 - open, for BDOI confirmation: E-policies linked to migrated accounts (BRID_MIG 14.2). Proposed: One load of the e-policies of the in-force migrated accounts from an index file (legacy account reference, insurer, insurer policy number, file name, checksum) into the BIBS documents of the account, matched on insurer and insurer policy number; an unmatched or ambiguous file is listed on an exception report and never linked; an audit report lists the linked and failed files with times and reasons (FR-DM-131). E-policies received after go-live are attached through the normal e-policy function of Placement Decision requested: The Head of Operations (Placement) says where the e-policies are held, which accounts they cover (in force only or also expired), the reference to match on and the volume, and whether the linking is a one-time load
